translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: A jun b'it tic ix b'oji yic sb'itej vin̈aj Jedutún, vin̈ cuchb'um d'a b'it. Sb'it jun tic vin̈aj David.

content.text: Ix vac' pensar to ol in ya'ilej in b'eyb'al, yic max och in mul yuj tas svala'. Tzin yamoch vaan in ti' yacb'an ayec' eb' anima chuc spensar d'a vichan̈.
Ix in em numnajoc, majxo valpaxlaj vach' lolonel. Palta axo in yaelal ix te nivtaji.
Vanxo stz'a in pixan ix vab'i. Yacb'an van in te naub'tan̈ani, ix vach' och pitz'an d'a in pixan. Yuj chi' chaan̈ ix in avaji, ix valani:
Mamin Jehová, ac' val vojtaquejeli to chamel b'a vaji, to jayen̈ej ab'il in q'uinal. In gana snachajel vuuj to elan̈chamel tz'ec'b'at in q'uinal.
Quenn̈ej in q'uinal ix ac'a'. Man̈ nivanoclaj in q'uinal d'a ichan̈. A on̈ anima on̈ tic, icha val quic'an jab'oc quic', icha chi' co q'uinal.
Icha veven caj co masanil. Nab'an̈ej sco mac' c'unb'oc co b'a. ¿Tocval scac' co gana yed' co b'eyumal sco molb'ejq'ue b'ulan? Man̈ cojtacoc mach ol ic'ancanb'atoc.
Mamin Vajal, axo ticnaic, ¿tas vach' svac'och yipoc in c'ool? A ach ton ayach och yipoc in c'ool.
Colinel d'a masanil in chucal. Man̈ in a cha b'uchjoc yuj eb' chuc spensar.
Icha val eb' max ujilaj sloloni, icha chi' ix vutej in b'a. Man̈xalaj tas ix elta d'a in ti', yujto a ach tic ix ac'och juntzan̈ tic d'ayin.
Iq'uel in yaelal ix ac'ochi. Vanxo in lajviel svab' yuj b'aj ix in a mac'a'.

A ach tzac'och co yaelal a on̈ anima on̈ tic. Tzac'anoch co tz'uumal yuj co mul. A ach tzac' lajvoc tas nib'ab'il cuuj, ichato tz'ijaxb'ati. Co masanil, icha val quic'an quic', icha chi' yec' co q'uinal.

Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal tic, cotan̈ q'uelan d'ayin ayic svalan in b'a d'ayach. Man̈ ac' sat a c'ool d'a yal in sat tic. Mamin, a d'ayach, eq'uelb'an̈ej vec' d'a sat luum tic icha eb' in mam vicham.
Mamin, man̈ ac'cot a c'ac'alc'olal d'ayin, yic vach' tzin tzalaj junoc rato, yacb'an manto el-laj in c'ool.
